clean_apply.method: the generated patch reverse-applies cleanly to the current overlay on the pinned base, proving the overlay bytes are exactly the patch result

corpus_qualification: this milestone closes the remaining fixed-static firmware GOT relocation family with a generated relocation-complete execution fixture; it makes no claim that these relocations are frequent in the retained firmware corpus

fixed_static_got_family_contract.default_policy: reject atomically with no candidate and require --firmbolt-arm-got=fixed-static
fixed_static_got_family_contract.handler: BOLT recognizes, sizes, extracts, range-checks and encodes all three relocation types, retains the logical GOT-origin and target identities, and binds scratch-link edges to the exact retained firmware graph instead of synthesizing a hosted GOT

absolute_literal_address.diagnostic: changed the observable address from 0x8000140 to 0x8000118

fixed_static_got_family_contract.policy: one exact retained file-backed non-executable .got origin, no interpreter, no dynamic slot relocation, exact symbol identities, and fixed non-executable targets
fixed_static_got_family_contract.transformation: whole-image ordering moves got_family_worker from 0x08000128 to 0x08000100 and its three owned relocation words from 0x08000140-0x08000148 to 0x08000118-0x08000120 while retaining the fixed RAM graph, mapping transitions, twelve instruction origins and execution result

scope_limits: the qualified policy covers one exact section named .got; additional firmware schemas require explicit typed metadata
dynamic GOT and PLT construction, runtime relocation, symbol interposition and hosted loader behavior remain unsupported
GOTOFF32 targets are limited to fixed non-executable segments because moved executable targets would require a different rebinding contract
the generic AArch32 JITLink layer represents these request edges, while FirmBOLT's firmware binder supplies the qualified GOT origin and graph
the literal-address negative proves atomic rejection of one changed observable placement; it is not whole-firmware semantic equivalence
the production matrix demonstrates no regression across the existing firmware corpus, not complete x86-backend parity
the milestone establishes reference-graph, relocation, publication and architectural-execution correctness, not a performance result

source.aaelf32: R_ARM_BASE_PREL computes B(S)+A-P, R_ARM_GOT_BREL computes G(S)+A-GOT_ORG, and R_ARM_GOTOFF32 computes S+A-GOT_ORG
source.pinned_bolt_gap: the ARM relocation handler and AArch32 JITLink layer did not recognize types 24-26, and hosted GOT construction cannot supply a fixed bare-metal firmware origin and graph
source.policy_boundary: FirmBOLT implements only an explicit fixed-static firmware graph and rejects unqualified, dynamic or executable-target interpretations
